summary: OWNER-MINER-RESEARCH-SURFACE-01 (owner, 2026-10-02: "we were supposed to be working to a branded version of this. Whatever you as an agent think is an optimal work surface for you and the miner"; then "where can you see the Julia/JAX/Pytorch tooling and all of that in the control center? And where can you talk to your agent?"): the Control Center gains a branded research surface for the miner and their agent (C-MLP-05). One allow-listed campaign view drives every panel and is the operation campaign_view, so the browser and carbon_campaign_view return the same document: the real lifecycle as four stages (research, practice runs, candidate frozen, DEVELOPMENT submit), halt and resume, tiles from existing data with spend from the miner's own ledger, practice components current against previous, trend charts, and the Challenge's contract with an empty construction-level slot. Charts are drawn by output kind (time series, scalar, checkpoint vector, 2D field) from each Challenge's declared research view, battery first and a synthetic second Challenge in tests. Per-case predicted-vs-reference curves are public PRACTICE only, allowed by battery's practice disclosure contract (detailed_own_public_practice), computed locally from digest-verified predictions, and fail closed otherwise. carbon_note posts bounded untrusted text to the journal; attach now brings the research prompts and the skill. The toolbox (carbon_toolbox, a Tools tab and each Challenge card) is read from the Challenge's records: JAX and PyTorch runtimes, Julia research-only with its blocker, workspace and workflow tools with their MCP names. The miner writes to their own agent from the page; any MCP agent reads with carbon_messages and replies with carbon_note, and a message changes nothing frozen at launch. Open owner questions: a battery learning curve needs a worker change (RSURF-D3); Carbon's own agent reading messages would amend C-MLP-02-D6 and stays off (RSURF-D13). DEVELOPMENT, testnet 567; practice evidence is not qualification; the demo fixture is synthetic and cannot reach a campaign or LIVE.
